title: Refactor CI stage graph to declarative manifests and introduce dependency gating
author: Diego Martinez
description: Motivation: Our monolithic CI stage graph has become increasingly hard to reason about and expensive to maintain. Small changes to the orchestration code were triggering widespread presubmit churn and made it difficult to apply targeted presubmit behavior (e.g. fastpath lint-only lanes, staged release smoke). This PR refactors the CI execution graph into a set of declarative stage manifests and implements a dependency gating layer that blocks merges when a curated set of transitive dependencies are flagged as unsafe. The intent is to make CI change-aware, reduce presubmit surface, and give the dep-safety team a simple manifest-driven way to apply quarantines without code changes. Summary of work: 1) introduce a manifest schema (ci/manifests/*.yaml) that declaratively defines stages, resource profiles, shard selectors and fallbacks; 2) runtime: replace the inlined stage-graph builder with a small interpreter that composes manifests into the execution plan; 3) dep-gating: add a dependency-gate step to presubmit that consults dep-snapshot and the Dep Quarantine list, failing fast for affected PRs; 4) migrate existing lint/test/release pipelines to manifests and add lightweight compatibility layer for older pipeline annotations; 5) improve observability: add per-stage telemetry and a small CLI tool (scripts/ci/manifest-inspect) to preview the plan locally. Impact: reduced presubmit average wall-clock time for small repo-only changes by ~22% in our experiments (see CI run history), and a clear operational path to quarantine transitive deps without runtime rollouts. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout across three phases: opt-in manifest mode on canary runners, mirror mode (manifests + legacy graph), and finally deprecate the legacy builder. Checklist: - [x] manifest schema RFC and schema tests - [x] interpreter implementation with unit tests - [x] presubmit dep-gate integrated and tested against mirror snapshot - [x] migration scripts for top-20 pipelines - [x] small e2e smoke on canary runners - [x] docs: ci/manifests/README.md and devdocs/ci-declarative.md - [x] added telemetry and local preview tool Notes: This description is intentionally a single contiguous string; additional context is present in commits and review thread below.

release_notes:
- Introduce declarative CI manifests (ci/manifests) to define stages, shards and fallbacks.
- Add manifest interpreter and local preview tool (scripts/ci/manifest-inspect).
- Add presubmit dependency-gate that prevents merges when transitive quarantined deps are present.
- Migration scripts for the top-20 pipelines; staged rollout behind a feature flag.
operational_impact: Canary deployment rolled out to 3 runners on 2025-11-17. Observed ~22% presubmit wall-clock improvement for small edits. Dep-team can now quarantine transitive deps via configs/dep-quarantine-list.json without runtime releases. Metrics and rate-limits added to avoid snapshot service overload.
